node.title: Official-row quantifier pinning: no hidden finite prime list
node.statement: The grand challenges quantify over every admissible choice of F, L, and k, subject to the printed bounds and sufficiently-large-field proviso; they do not specify a hidden finite list of official row primes. A prize-facing certificate must therefore be family-uniform, or else be explicitly scoped only to its named exhibit field. A stand-in or named exhibit does not certify the universal family without a proved transport theorem.
node.notes: PROVED on replay (Codex citation/reframe packet, verifier PASS): the challenge quantifies over admissible F with a sufficiently-large-field proviso — no literal prime list exists to pin; obligations are family-uniform or exhibit-specific.
